OPEN-01: Please state your full name and your spouse’s full name. Who is conducting this interview, and what is today’s date and the case number?
BASIS-01: What are you asking the council to decide, and what facts support your request?
BASIS-02: Is any information in your application incorrect or in need of clarification? If so, what needs to be corrected or explained?
DEC-02: Before marriage, what did you understand your responsibilities in married life would be, and what had you and your spouse discussed about them?
DEC-04: What did you learn later that differed from what you understood when you decided to marry? When and how did you learn it, and what information supports your account?
CHD-03: Did your or your spouse’s plans about children change after marriage, or did you later discover something about your spouse’s earlier plans? What changed or became known, and when and how did you learn about it?
MON-02: Before marriage, was any important financial information kept from you or described differently from what you later learned? What was the information, what were you told, and by whom?
MON-05: What evidence supports your account of the financial matter, and what is still uncertain or disputed?
PRS-01: Was there any pressure, threat or other circumstance that affected your decision to marry? If so, what happened?
PRS-04: What did you personally experience or observe, and what evidence or information from that time supports your account?
DBT-01: What serious doubts or concerns, if any, did you have before the wedding?
WED-01: Did anything happen immediately before or during the wedding that affected your willingness or ability to go ahead with it? If so, what happened?
CON-01: Before marriage, do you believe someone gave you false information or kept an important fact from you? What was the fact, who was involved, and what were you told or not told?
CON-05: What evidence supports the events you have described, and what is still uncertain?
INF-01: Describe the affair or adultery you are reporting. Who was involved, what do you say happened, and when and where did it happen, if known?
INF-02: When do you believe the affair or adultery occurred, if known? When and how did you first learn about it?
ABD-04: Which dates and reasons for the absence or separation do you know, which are estimates, and which are unknown? What information supports the dates and reasons you have given?
ABU-01: Describe the abuse you are reporting. What happened, who was involved, and when and where did it happen? Was it a single incident or repeated behavior?
FTH-01: To your knowledge, what church, denomination or religion did each of you belong to before you knew each other?
FTH-02: What change in your or your spouse’s church, faith or religious practice relates to your request? When did it happen?
BKG-01: Did anything happen before marriage that directly relates to the issue you are asking the council to consider? If so, what happened and how does it relate?
BKG-02: What happened, and how does it relate to the issue being discussed? What did you personally experience or observe, and what were you told by someone else?
SEP-02: For each separation, when did it begin and end, approximately, and why did you separate? Did you later resume living together? If so, when and why?
SEP-04: What information supports your account of the separations, and which dates are uncertain?
REC-03: What outcome of the reconciliation attempt did you personally observe, and what did you learn from someone else?
REC-04: What information is still missing, and what existing records could help clarify it?
EVD-04: Is there any uncertainty, conflicting information or limitation in the evidence you have provided that the council should know about? If so, please explain.
MED-03: What do you personally know about the relevant evaluation, treatment or professional help? What were you told by someone else, and what is unknown to you?
